title: Jab maula mehdi aaenge
body:
Jab maula mehdi aaenge
Maula Maula..(2)
ya mahdi..(20)
jab noor ka suraj chamkega
<<DIVIDER>>
karwat yeh zamana badlega
sab chand sitare mehdi ki chaukhat ke diye ban jaaega
dekhega zamane yeh manzar dar baite ali ka khultey hi
deewaare haram ke sab patthar haider haider dohraaengey
<<DIVIDER>>
jab maula mehdi aaengey
jo gaasibey haqqe zahra hai..(2)
qabro se uthaae jaaengey
kaabe ko sajaya jaaega badlega zamane ka manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
tayyariye jashne eide ghadeer is tarah karengey woh aakar
jannat ke purane darzi se
malboos naye silwaaengey
kuch ibne adam aisey hai adam ke amal par hai barham
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid ke aagey hotey hue jo dekh nahi saktey hotey matam
jab matam hoga kaabe me
woh jal jal ke mar jaaegey
qaem ki adalat me ek din woh pesh sabhi mujrim hogey
<<DIVIDER>>
har daur me mimbar par chadke jo bughze ali mei boltey the
hai mujhko yakeen maula unki
meesam se zabaa khichwaaengey
nasir abbas taqi hadi sibte jafar mohsin naqvi
<<DIVIDER>>
tehzeeb wajahat asif ho yaa aun sa matamdaar koi
jab hogi baqiyya mei majlis
yeh saare hume miljaaegey
dekhega jahaan yun ahle aza ka rutba badhaya jaega
<<DIVIDER>>
khatune qayamat ka rauza jab firse banaya jaaega
chun chun kar matami halko se
mazdoor bulaae jaaengey
kya hoga qayamat ka manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
kuffar ki dunya larzegi
baalo ko chudaate khaak ko jab utthengey lahad se maula ali
fir fauj me apne bete ki
woh khud shamil ho jaaegey
<<DIVIDER>>
haider ki wilayat ka dushman tauheed ka dushman hota hai
tauheed ke waris hai mehdi tab bhi mera dil yeh kehta hai
dushman hai wilaayat ke jitney
woh pehle maare jaaengey
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch bhi toh nahi hai tayyari hoto pe zabani yeh daawa hai
aa jaae agar woh milne ko kya koi aisa gosha hai
jhaako toh makaamo me apne
hum unko kaha tehraaengey
<<DIVIDER>>
wallah khadi reh jaaegi har nasle umayya ki saazish
kya jandullah kya ainusra alqaeda kya kaisi daaish
jab teg ali ki chamkegi
sab mitti mei mil jaaegey
<<DIVIDER>>
nazdik takallum hai woh ghadi dekhengey jab yeh ahle nazar
kya mufti hafiz maulana sab rashk karegey woh mujhpar
mimbar pe kasida zahra ka
woh padhne mujhe bulwaaengey
<<DIVIDER>>
author: Mir Hassan Mir
